commands.name: boat

commands.doc: Print the key registry.

commands.name: config show
commands.doc: Print every key that has a value, with the source of the value.

commands.name: dwd house

commands.doc: Read a MOSMIX_L forecast of one station.

commands.name: dwd obs
commands.doc: Read CDC station observations.

commands.name: dwd stations
commands.doc: List the DWD stations nearest to a position.

commands.doc: Run the boat twin on irradiance from the history archive.

commands.name: history-twin house
commands.doc: Run the house twin on weather years from the history archive.

commands.name: history-twin twin
commands.doc: Run twin scenario S1 (H2 chain) on prices and wind from the history archive.

commands.name: house
commands.doc: Run the house twin: KPIs of the reference year and every lever as a what-if.

commands.name: kafscale-check
commands.doc: Check that a KafScale bootstrap address and its advertised brokers are reachable.

commands.name: market backfill
commands.doc: Fill the history archive with market series for a range of years.

commands.name: market catalog
commands.doc: List the market series the collector knows.

commands.name: market forward
commands.doc: Fetch the market series of the previous and the running year (daily job).

commands.name: market import
commands.doc: Import a partner CSV file into the history archive.

commands.name: market load
commands.doc: Load archived series as episodes into Iceberg or an in-memory store.

commands.name: market marktwert
commands.doc: Fetch the market values of all technologies.

commands.name: market mosmix-archive
commands.doc: Archive the raw MOSMIX_L forecasts of stations.

commands.name: market prices
commands.doc: Fetch day-ahead prices.

commands.name: market publish
commands.doc: Publish archived series as raw episodes to the episodes topic of a domain.

commands.name: market rebap
commands.doc: Fetch both sides of the imbalance price reBAP.

commands.name: market report
commands.doc: Print the manifests and quality reports of the archived series.

commands.name: market series
commands.doc: Fetch one series of the catalog.

commands.name: market weather-backfill
commands.doc: Fill the history archive with DWD CDC observations of the twin sites.

commands.name: market weather-forward
commands.doc: Fetch the DWD CDC observations of the previous and the running year (daily job).

commands.name: metadata
commands.doc: Publish the wind-farm metadata pool to OpenMetadata.

commands.doc: Validate a register map and print its points and read plan.

commands.name: modbus poll
commands.doc: Poll a meter repeatedly.

commands.name: modbus read
commands.doc: Run one poll cycle and print it as a table.

commands.name: modbus simulate
commands.doc: Serve a simulated meter over Modbus TCP.

commands.name: retrieval-server
commands.doc: Serve the REST API for episodes, patterns, segments, DAGs and systems.

commands.name: stats
commands.doc: Run the streaming statistics processor on KafScale.

commands.name: stats-flink
commands.doc: Run the streaming statistics as a Flink job in a local mini cluster.

commands.name: studio-export
commands.doc: Write the scenario data of the Smart Topics Studio to a JSON file.

commands.name: twin
commands.doc: Run twin scenario S1 (H2 chain) in the modes shadow, what-if and forecast.

commands.name: twin-coupling
commands.doc: Compare coupling variant L with variant T over a grid of staleness bounds and latencies.

commands.name: twin-live bridge
commands.doc: Serve event topics to browsers as server-sent events.

commands.name: twin-live demo
commands.doc: Run publisher and bridge in one process on topics kept in memory.

commands.name: twin-live publish
commands.doc: Write the events of the reference runs to their event topics.

commands.name: twin-schemas
commands.doc: Regenerate the Avro topic contract of the twin.

commands.name: vectors
commands.doc: Run the vector processor of a domain (same as vectors run).

commands.doc: Deploy a DAG to the vector processor, or replace it, through the control topic.

commands.name: vectors run
commands.doc: Run the vector processor of a domain.

commands.name: vectors stop
commands.doc: Stop a DAG of the vector processor through the control topic.

commands.name: version
commands.doc: Print the OpenTSx version.

commands.name: windpark-sim
commands.doc: Run a wind-farm scenario and write its episodes to KafScale, Iceberg or both.
